div.div: Shows the total number of employees based on selected filters Click to view employees

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Shows employee attendance compared to expected workdays Formula: (Attendance Days ÷ Net Work Days) × 100 Click to view attendance records

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Shows the number of completed tasks during the selected period Formula: Count of Tasks with State = Done Click to view completed tasks

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Measures productivity by Formula: (Completed Tasks ÷ Total Tasks) × 100 Click to view all tasks

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Measures total assigned workload hours for active tasks Formula: Sum of Allocated Active Task Hours Click to view pending tasks

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Measures the percentage of employees who left the company Formula:(Employees Left ÷ Average Employees)× 100 Click to view left employees

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Shows Total Number of employees who completed sales orders successfully Formula: Count of Employees with Sales Orders Click to view confirmed sales

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Measures approved leave days compared to expected workdays Formula: (Approved Leave Days ÷ Expected Work Days) × 100 Click to view leave records

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Shows the percentage of employee absence Formula: 100 − Attendance Rate Click to view absence analysis

div.class: wb-card p-3 h-100 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer

div.div: Identifies staff members with high workload hours but low task completion output indicating possible workflow delays or performance bottlenecks Formula: Employee Workload > Average Workload AND Completed Tasks < Average Completed Tasks Click to view bottleneck employees

div.h6:
Workload Analysis
i
Visualizes the distribution of labor hours across top employees or groups Click chart sections to view workload details

select.class: form-select form-select-sm w-auto wb-input rounded-pill px-3

div.h6:
Productivity vs Workload
i
Correlates 'Assigned Hours' with 'Tasks Completed' to evaluate staff performance stability Click any point to view employee task analysis

Productivity Variance
i
Shows department productivity and performance variation to spot performance gaps Formula: Productivity Rate AND Performance Variance Analysis Click to on productivity or variance to show more information about it

Performance & Stability Analysis (Productivity vs. Turnover)
i
Monitors the monthly relationship between workforce turnover rates and overall productivity efficiency Click trend points to view productivity details or turnover details
